The heading hierarchy is logical. Section titles function as top-level headings, and sub-headings within sections are correctly tagged as H3. There are no skipped levels or logically inconsistent nestings.

There are major failures in table structural fidelity across multiple pages.

2. On Page 5 (Section 4), the 'Certified Budget Detail by Fund' table is entirely missing as a table object and is instead rendered as a single paragraph (element index 3).
3. On Page 5 (Section 4), the 'Position Counts' table at the bottom of the page is also rendered as a paragraph (element index 4) rather than a table object.
